message:
Flip working side for counters; one staff member per station

- Counters get a workFlip flag: staff side, walkway, customer side and equipment facing
  swap while the counter art stays put (Flip pill while placing, button in the popup)
- Register queue and pickup line follow the counter working side (registers on turned
  counters used to queue as if facing the default way)
- Hiring and auto-assign skip any station someone works or stands at; collisions start
  at an empty counter, else on a counter walkway
